g.text: Search Autocomplete -- LLD: Atomic Snapshot Swap
A reader's request always finishes against one whole, immutable trie generation -- never a half-built one
Reader A -- request starts before the swap
finishes against v41 -- consistent, never torn
Reader B -- request starts after the swap
reads v42 from the start -- already fresher
Neither reader locks, blocks, or observes a partially-updated node -- each resolves to whichever whole snapshot was current when its walk began.
